name: Form pony

unlock.how: found in the bug report form

tips: A good bug report says what you did, what you expected, and what happened instead. With those three, someone else can see the problem too.
Write the steps to make the bug happen again, one command per line. A bug that the developer can repeat is a bug that gets fixed.
Paste error messages as text, in full, not just a summary. The exact words help people search for the cause.
personal: Steps, expected, actual. Then the bug has nowhere to hide.
Thank you for reporting! Every bug report makes the game better.
